findings.fact: A complete64-observable moment representation is a basis transform of the existing density generator, or a representation of its adjoint. It does not construct new dynamics or solve the physical reduction by itself.
findings.scope: For moments m_A=Tr(rho A), define T rows vec(A^T)^T; if full basis, M=T L T^-1. Complex non-Hermitian coordinates require this bilinear trace convention, not an unqualified conjugate transpose. No matrixM or rank was computed here. A minimal invariant/Krylov subspace would be genuinely additional, but not necessary for full-state readout.

findings.scope: These are complete joint mathematical preparations, no need to invent another. They are not derived preparation channels of the patented apparatus; product structure and q are INPUT.
